name: Larry Fink

summary.text: Laurence D. (Larry) Fink co-founded BlackRock in 1988 and serves as its Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. Before BlackRock he worked at the investment bank First Boston, where CNBC describes him as a pioneer in the mortgage bond market and the firm's youngest managing director; in 1986 his mortgage department lost $100 million in a single quarter and he left the bank two years later. BlackRock began under the corporate umbrella of The Blackstone Group before separating in the 1990s.

facts.claim: BlackRock's proxy statements state that Larry Fink co-founded BlackRock in 1988; he is the company's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

CNBC reported that at First Boston Fink became the bank's youngest managing director and was a pioneer in the mortgage bond market, but that in 1986 his mortgage department lost $100 million in a single quarter, and that two years later he was out.
facts.quote: He might have been fitted for the crown at the investment bank, now owned by Credit Suisse, but in 1986 his mortgage department lost $100 million in a single quarter. Two years later he was out.

facts.claim: A 2010 Vanity Fair profile, as quoted by AOL, said that Fink's mortgage business had added, by some estimates, about $1 billion to First Boston's bottom line before the 1986 loss.
facts.quote: added, by some estimates, about $1 billion to First Boston's bottom line

facts.claim: Wikipedia states that in 1988, under the corporate umbrella of The Blackstone Group, Fink co-founded BlackRock and became its director and CEO, that BlackRock split from Blackstone in 1994, and that Fink became chairman in 1998 after BlackRock became independent. (Wikipedia; the owner should replace this with a primary source before approval.)
facts.quote: in 1988, under the corporate umbrella of The Blackstone Group, Fink co-founded BlackRock and became its director and CEO / when BlackRock split from Blackstone in 1994, Fink retained his positions, becoming chairman in 1998 after BlackRock became independent

connections.claim: Larry Fink is Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of BlackRock, the only CEO the company has had since its founding in 1988.
BlackRock began in 1988 under the corporate umbrella of The Blackstone Group and separated from it in 1994 (Wikipedia; primary source needed).
connections.quote: in 1988, under the corporate umbrella of The Blackstone Group, Fink co-founded BlackRock and became its director and CEO
